sentences: How much thermal paste should you use?
Thermal paste fills the microscopic gaps between your processor and its cooler.
Air is a terrible conductor of heat, and the paste pushes it out.
The common advice is a dot about the size of a pea, right in the middle.
When you mount the cooler, the pressure spreads it out.
Too much just squeezes out the sides and makes a mess, without cooling any better.
Many come with paste already applied, so you may not need any extra.
